entry.title: Color as a Generative Principle in the Work of Sonia Delaunay
entry.summary: An art-historical research study examining color as an autonomous, relational and generative principle in the artistic practice of Sonia Delaunay. The research explores simultaneism, painting, textile design, perception and the structural relationship between modernist color theory and contemporary digital visual systems.
